verdict.rationale: Whether an API platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says Postman's source code is published or released under an open license. Mentions of the CLI, the Postman API and Newman describe functionality only, not licensing or source access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
